title: Gallery Questionnaire: Assessing your design using Multimedia Gallery Framework
descriptions: Understanding of designing multimedia gallery by distributing an open ended survey to the students after they have completed their final design. Consent was obtained from each student during class to participate in the survey. Thoughts and ideas of their concept and design were collected and processed to find out more on their understanding of multimedia gallery design.
